scripts.build: npm run build -w @football-vision/shared && npm run build -w @football-vision/api
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @football-vision/shared && npm run dev -w @football-vision/api
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build -w @football-vision/shared && npm run worker -w @football-vision/api
scripts.test: npm run build -w @football-vision/shared && npm run test:unit -w @football-vision/api
scripts.test:integration: npm run build -w @football-vision/shared && npm run test:integration -w @football-vision/api
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:integration && npm run test:vision
